text:
sara_sales: Hey team — running a POC with AcmeCorp, customer sees 403 on every call after first token usage. They're calling /v1/generate with an API key we gave them. Can someone triage? (urgent, demo tomorrow)

ryan_se: Can you paste the curl and the exact response body?

sara_sales: curl snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer rk_test_ABC123" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-org" \n  -d '{"model":"gptx-small","input":"hi"}'
```
Response: `{ "error": { "code": 403, "message": "invalid_key: key does not belong to org" } }`

mina_se: That error usually means the API key is bound to a different org or the request is missing project header. Are you using org-level key or project-scoped key?

sara_sales: We generated the key from the sandbox org for the POC workspace; customer using same org header we provided.

kate_support: @sara_sales can you DM me the key id (just the last 6 chars) and the customer org_id? I'll check the binding.

alex_sre: Also check if they're using 'rk_' (runtime key) vs 'sk_' (service key). Service keys are org-scoped and not valid for client-side calls.

sara_sales: key ends with ...D4F9, org_id is 'acme-corp-prod'

infra_bot: log entry found for key rk_test_ABC123 -> bound_org: acme-corp-staging; expected_org: acme-corp-prod; rejection_count: 3

ryan_se: ok looks like we issued a key tied to staging org. Two options: 1) rebind the key to acme-corp-prod (requires owner consent) or 2) issue a new key scoped to the prod org. Recommend new key.

mina_se: Also check scopes: client should have `generate` scope. If the key lacks 'generate' it'll 403 with 'insufficient_scope'.

sara_sales: customer also asking about rate limits — demo will hit ~50 qps briefly. Is there a quick way to raise limit for POC?

kate_support: We can temporary bump burst limits for a day; need written approval from sales ops. @sara_sales can you add a one-line approval and cc @sales-ops?

sara_sales: done — approval sent, subject "AcmeCorp POC burst limit approval".

alex_sre: For immediate unblock, I'll create a new key in prod org with generate scope and mark it as expiring in 24h. Will post it here when done.

(10 minutes pass)

alex_sre: New runtime key created: rk_temp_prod_7GZ — NOTE: rotate after demo. Key is limited to 24h and generate scope only.

sara_sales: pasted to customer, they still see 403 but now error message is `project_mismatch: request project 'acme-demo' not allowed for key`

ryan_se: Are they sending X-Redwood-Project header? If project is not whitelisted for that key, it will reject.

sara_sales: they are sending `X-Redwood-Project: acme-demo`

mina_se: We need to add 'acme-demo' to the key's allowed projects or create a project-scoped key. Which project should they use in prod?

sara_sales: customer wants to use demo project; it's created in their org.

kate_support: Added acme-demo to allowed_projects for rk_temp_prod_7GZ. @alex_sre please verify logs.

infra_bot: log update: key rk_temp_prod_7GZ -> allowed_projects updated: [acme-demo]; request from 198.51.100.23 accepted

sara_sales: Demo passing now, latency looks fine. Huge thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) Can we get a non-expiring key for longer POC? 2) Customer asked about SSO and security questionnaire answers for key binding.

ryan_se: For longer POC recommend dedicated service key with expiry 90 days and project whitelist. That requires SOC review if they ask for on-prem details.

kate_support: I'll start the security questionnaire items (KMS/HSM, audit logs) and ping you for specifics. @sara_sales I'll draft language about key binding and rotation.

sara_sales: Perfect — sending recap to customer and the demo went well. Thanks all :tada: 

alex_sre: Added a ticket INF-2543 to make the project-binding error message more actionable (link internal)

mina_se: small note for docs: show explicit example headers (Authorization + X-Redwood-Org + X-Redwood-Project) and mention common gotchas.

sara_sales: will update the POC playbook with steps. Closing thread after I confirm customer signs SOW.

kate_support: I'll attach the questionnaire draft to the ticket.

sara_sales: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
